title: Program Proposal & Description
summary: This module provides tools for analyzing datasets, describing program functionality, and generating optimized instructions for language models. It helps in understanding and refining the components of a DSPy program.

nodes.label: Summarize Dataset Observations
nodes.title: Summarize Dataset Observations
nodes.description: Condenses detailed observations about a dataset into a brief, 2-3 sentence summary, focusing on the most significant highlights and trends identified.

nodes.label: Describe Dataset Trends
nodes.title: Describe Dataset Trends
nodes.description: Analyzes sample data points from a dataset to identify consistent trends, topics, content, and syntax, and makes an educated guess about the dataset's underlying task.

nodes.label: Describe Dataset with Prior Observations
nodes.title: Describe Dataset with Prior Observations
nodes.description: Examines dataset examples to identify trends, incorporating and building upon a set of provided prior observations. It can also indicate if observations are complete.

nodes.label: Describe Program Functionality
nodes.title: Describe Program Functionality
nodes.description: Analyzes pseudocode and an example of a language model program to articulate the task it is designed to solve and explain its operational methodology.

nodes.label: Describe Module Role
nodes.title: Describe Module Role
nodes.description: Provides a detailed description of the specific purpose and function of an individual module within the context of a larger language model program.

nodes.label: Generate Module Instruction
nodes.title: Generate Module Instruction
nodes.description: Generates a new, optimized instruction for a Language Model to improve its performance on a specific task, leveraging various contextual inputs like dataset summaries, program details, and past attempts.

nodes.label: Format Instruction History
nodes.title: Format Instruction History
nodes.description: Processes trial logs to extract and format a string containing the top-performing instruction sets and their associated scores, providing historical context for instruction generation.

groups.label: Dataset Analysis
groups.title: Dataset Analysis
groups.description: Components focused on analyzing and summarizing characteristics and trends within datasets.

groups.label: Program & Module Description
groups.title: Program & Module Description
groups.description: Components responsible for describing the functionality of entire programs and individual modules within them.

groups.label: Instruction Generation
groups.title: Instruction Generation
groups.description: Components that generate and refine instructions for language models based on various contextual inputs.

groups.label: Utility Functions
groups.title: Utility Functions
groups.description: Helper functions for processing and formatting data, often supporting other core components.
